title: SBJ Daily: Adobe, MLB expand AI tools; PGA Tour changes on the horizon
article_content: Sports Business Journal reports on the growing adoption of AI across sports, including Adobe's and MLB's expanded AI-powered analytics and fan-engagement tools, and discusses implications for team operations, marketing, and monetization strategies.

additional_sources.title: Adobe and Major League Baseball Expand Partnership to Power AI-Driven Fan Experiences
additional_sources.article_content: Adobe expands MLB partnership to bring AI-powered creativity and personalized fan experiences across digital channels; includes opening-day sponsorship through 2028 and broader use across marketing and content creation.

market_context_source.title: Sports Industry Outlook 2026 North America - PwC
market_context_source.article_content: The North America Sports Industry Outlook 2026 emphasizes digital fan engagement, membership-driven ticketing, AI-enabled operations, and athlete economics as core levers of growth as venues transform and media ecosystems converge.
